ops.title: Retrofit isHidden on remaining visible FP domains as accounts go idle
ops.description: The v0.52.1 isHidden fix only applies at domain creation; the 12 domains on this Mac (acct-01,04,05,06,07,08,10,11,12,13,14,15) were registered pre-fix and stay visible in Finder Locations until a remove+re-add. Retrofit = `ccp fp repair --account N`, but ONLY when the account has zero live sessions (repair breaks open FDs on the domain). Sweep is running in session these-fp-ones-are-floating-conway on 2026-07-14; this task covers whatever remains if that session ends first. acct-11 must be repaired only when no session runs on it (it hosted the sweep session itself). Prereq (done by the sweep session unless it died early): cc-pool + cc-pool-status upgraded to v0.54.0, daemon restarted, CCPoolStatus.app relaunched with consent granted.

ops.text: Every CCPoolStatus-acct-NN domain is absent from Finder's Locations sidebar (fileproviderctl dump still lists all 12 domains — hidden, not removed)
Each repaired account still serves reads through its config dir and ccp doctor is clean
